posts.headline: Twenty straight editions of nothing from One Nut Barner, and Put it in Ra's league-best 1.5 average finish is now looking wobbly at 0-1 with 123.66 points that won't cut it against a 20-8 pedigree.
posts.detail: Twenty editions of dead air is its own kind of streak, but the 20-8 career record demands better than back-to-back weeks of quiet mediocrity.

posts.headline: Sasinci is 0-1 and buried at 101.6 points for the second straight week — Big Head's title banner is now hanging by a thread with a 13-15 career record doing him zero favors.
posts.detail: Two weeks, two brutal scores, and the reigning-tier pedigree of 5.5 average finish is looking generous at this point.

posts.headline: tristanthepiston opened 1-0 at 177.8 points, and for once the Mexican Bald Fraud actually showed up instead of just talking about it.
posts.detail: A 7-7 career record and 7th-place average finish is nothing to brag about, but 177.8 points is the second-best total in the league this week — grudging respect, for now.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh is somehow still unbeaten, but 120.4 points is still the third-lowest total in the league — the untalented tenth is winning ugly and living on borrowed time.
posts.detail: A 4-10 career record with a dead-last 12th-place finish doesn't get erased by one shaky win; the receipts are still due.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is still stuck in the fire-and-brimstone era after a league-worst 72.02 points, and the Ultimate Light Skin's judgment day keeps getting rescheduled.
posts.detail: A 13-14-1 career record was already shaky, and the man who once drafted a defensive player first overall is proving old habits die hard.
